column1: 她____了三年的奖学金，高兴极了。|She received a three-year scholarship and was delighted.|获得
我是2024年____的，学的是国际经济专业。|I enrolled in 2024 and studied international economics.|入学
我打算考研究生，提高自己的____水平。|I plan to take the postgraduate entrance exam to improve my professional level.|专业
咱们晚上别去____吃饭了，我请你出去吃饭吧。|Let's not eat at the dining hall tonight; I'll take you out.|食堂
王经理今天下午去办____了，您明天再来找他吧。|Manager Wang went to arrange a visa this afternoon; please come tomorrow.|签证
A：你____想做什么工作？ B：我想在国际公司工作，有更多的发展机会。|A: What work do you want in future? B: I want to work at an international company for more opportunities.|将来
A：你为什么选择这门课程？ B：因为我想认真____中国的历史和文化。|A: Why choose this course? B: I want to study Chinese history and culture seriously.|研究
A：今天下午公司有____，我晚点儿回家。 B：好。大概几点结束？需要我去接你吗？|A: There is an activity at work this afternoon; I'll be home later. B: When does it end? Shall I pick you up?|活动
A：你们要去哪儿？ B：我们要去给参加比赛的同学____，你去吗？|A: Where are you going? B: To cheer on classmates in the competition. Will you come?|加油
A：你们这次旅游怎么样？ B：虽然天气不太好，但是和朋友在一起，做____事情都很有意思。|A: How was your trip? B: The weather was poor, but anything is fun with friends.|任何
这个小区环境好，____也不高，一个月才5000元。|This neighbourhood has a good environment and low rent, only 5,000 yuan monthly.|房租
要____一个好房子也不容易，需要多多比较。|Renting a good home is not easy; you need to compare many.|租
我女儿每天都把房间____得干干净净的。|My daughter tidies her room very thoroughly every day.|收拾
这次比赛的通知已经发到大家的邮箱了，请注意____。|The competition notice has been emailed; please check it.|查看
____后我发现，宾馆房间的灯是坏的。|After checking in, I found the hotel room light was broken.|入住
A：我最近打算在公司附近租个房子。 B：那你上网____租房信息时，一定要小心，不要只看价格。|A: I plan to rent near work. B: Be careful when searching online; don't look only at price.|查找
A：你假期打算做什么？ B：我要先回家住几天，____跟朋友去上海玩。|A: What will you do on holiday? B: Stay at home for a few days, then visit Shanghai with friends.|接着
A：听说小区____有很多公司，很多年轻人都租住在附近。 B：是的，所以周末时特别热闹。|A: I hear there are many companies around the neighbourhood and young renters nearby. B: Yes, so weekends are lively.|周围
A：这个房子怎么样？ B：很大，____也大，里边除了沙发以外，还有一台大电视。|A: How is the home? B: Large, with a big living room containing a sofa and a large TV.|客厅
A：关于租什么样的房子合适，你还有什么好____？ B：除了离公司近以外，我觉得生活上方便也很重要。|A: Any other advice on a suitable rental? B: Besides being close to work, convenience matters.|建议
丽丽去快递站拿快递时，又____了一个快递。|When Lili collected a parcel, she also sent one.|寄
从这儿走到十字路口，再向左____，就是超市了。|Walk to the crossroads and turn left to reach the supermarket.|转
在十字路口等了半个小时，他们也没来，____我就一个人去图书馆了。|They did not arrive after half an hour, so I went to the library alone.|于是
在商场购物的时候，我喜欢用信用卡____。|When shopping at the mall, I like paying by credit card.|结账
我们到电影院的时候，电影____开始了。|The film was just beginning when we reached the cinema.|正好
A：我用____结账可以吗？ B：当然，这些一共125块。|A: May I pay in cash? B: Of course; the total is 125 yuan.|现金
A：这个工作要求对网络____很了解，你可以吗？ B：没问题，我做这方面的工作已经有五年了。|A: This job requires knowledge of network technology. Can you do it? B: Yes, I have five years' experience.|技术
A：你们能____这些货下午就送到吗？ B：您放心，我们有“闪送”服务，下午两点前就能送到。|A: Can you guarantee delivery this afternoon? B: Yes, our instant delivery can arrive before two.|保证
A：这个商场特别漂亮，在这里____很舒服。 B：是啊，周末过来走走、看看，累了还可以坐下来喝喝咖啡或者茶。|A: This mall is beautiful and comfortable for shopping. B: Yes, and you can rest over coffee or tea.|购物
A：您好，办入住需要您____身份证和手机号后四位。 B：好的，这是我的身份证，手机号后四位是5063。|A: Check-in requires your ID and last four phone digits. B: Here is my ID; the digits are 5063.|提供
还____不少菜，我们带回家吃吧。|There is plenty of food left; let's take it home.|剩
外面的雨____了，咱们出去走走吧。|The rain has stopped; let's go for a walk.|停
同学____应该互相帮助、互相学习。|Classmates should help and learn from one another.|之间
今天我再准备一下材料，明天跟您____。|I'll prepare the materials today and contact you tomorrow.|联系
奶奶说她每天打扫房间，就____做运动了。|Grandma says cleaning her room every day counts as exercise.|算
A：你要去超市吗？能不能____帮我买个面包？ B：没问题。|A: Are you going to the supermarket? Could you get me some bread while there? B: Sure.|顺便
A：听说你最近一直坚持锻炼。 B：是的，我希望自己的身体____健康。|A: I hear you've kept exercising. B: Yes, I want to be even healthier.|更加
A：我发现街上很多人都穿绿色的衣服。 B：是啊，看来今年比较____绿色。|A: Many people are wearing green. B: Yes, green seems popular this year.|流行
A：咱们先休息休息吧，我一点儿____也没有了。 B：好，你先坐一会儿，我去给你买瓶饮料。|A: Let's rest; I have no strength left. B: Sit down; I'll buy you a drink.|力气
A：你每天走路上下班吗？ B：对，我家到公司的____不算远，走路大概半个小时。|A: Do you walk to work daily? B: Yes, it's not far, about half an hour.|距离
家里没____了，你去超市买一瓶吧。|We have no oil at home; buy a bottle at the supermarket.|油
这道菜看起来太辣了，我不____吃。|This dish looks too spicy; I dare not eat it.|敢
我____有点儿不舒服，想休息一下。|My stomach feels uncomfortable; I want to rest.|肚子
已经煮了十多分钟了，饺子____了吧？|They have cooked for over ten minutes; the dumplings should be done, right?|熟
这是我____为你准备的礼物，希望你喜欢。|I prepared this gift specially for you; I hope you like it.|专门
A：请问，这个____有人吗？ B：没有人，您坐吧。|A: Excuse me, is this seat taken? B: No, please sit.|座位
A：你尝尝，这道菜是不是做得太____了？ B：嗯，是的，我跟服务员说一下。|A: Try it: is this dish too salty? B: Yes, I'll tell the waiter.|咸
A：你们怎么还不吃？一会儿菜都____了。 B：我们在等你呢，一起吃更热闹。|A: Why aren't you eating? The food will go cold. B: We're waiting for you; eating together is livelier.|凉
A：我发现早上出来跑步的人变多了。 B：是啊，因为人们越来越____身体健康了。|A: More people are jogging in the morning. B: Yes, people increasingly value their health.|重视
A：这是我去超市帮你带的东西。 B：谢谢！多少钱？我把钱____给你。|A: Here is what I got for you at the supermarket. B: Thanks! How much? I'll pay you.|付
咱们过去问问____，看牙应该去几楼。|Let's ask the nurse which floor to go to for dental care.|护士
我这两天有点儿____，不知道是不是感冒了。|I've been coughing a little these two days; I wonder if it's a cold.|咳嗽
把你的____给我吧，我给你寄点儿东西。|Give me your address and I'll send you something.|地址
这个问题很____，我们必须马上想办法解决。|This problem is serious; we must find a solution immediately.|严重
你都发烧好几天了，____去医院检查一下吧。|You've had a fever for days; go to hospital for a check quickly.|赶快
A：这道菜是怎么做的？ B：下次我把做菜的____拍下来发给你。|A: How is this dish made? B: Next time I'll record the cooking process and send it.|过程
A：你今天怎么这么饿？ B：白天太忙了，____喝了点儿水，一口饭都没吃。|A: Why are you so hungry? B: I was busy and only drank water; I ate nothing.|光
A：经理叫你过去，要了解一下最近的工作____。 B：好的，我现在就去他的办公室。|A: The manager wants to see you about recent work. B: I'll go to his office now.|情况
A：我早上给你打电话，你怎么没接啊？ B：昨天睡得太晚了，今天10点才____。|A: Why didn't you answer this morning? B: I slept late and only woke at ten.|醒
A：你觉得看电影学中文怎么样？ B：我觉得这种方法很____，不但能学语言，还能了解中国文化。|A: What do you think of learning Chinese through films? B: It's effective for language and culture.|有效
发现问题以后，我们要____解决。|After finding a problem, we should solve it promptly.|及时
不好意思，这么晚还来____您休息。|Sorry to disturb your rest so late.|打扰
我刚才把家庭地址写错了，可以____一下吗？|I wrote my home address incorrectly; may I change it?|改
他和同事交流了一下，了解了大家的____。|He spoke with colleagues and learned their ideas.|想法
老师把学习材料放到了网上，____学生们复习。|The teacher put materials online to make revision easier.|便于
A：听说你最近一直坚持跑步。 B：是的，我觉得____很好，身体比以前好多了。|A: I hear you have kept running. B: Yes, the effect is good; I'm healthier.|效果
A：经理为什么让小王去做市场调查？ B：经理说他的____是很会和别人交流。|A: Why did the manager send Xiao Wang to do research? B: His strength is communication.|优点
A：我想学好中文，有什么建议吗？ B：刚开始的时候别太着急，先把____打好。|A: Any advice for learning Chinese well? B: Don't rush; build a good foundation first.|基础
A：你在大学学的是什么专业？ B：我学的是酒店____专业，现在在一家酒店工作。|A: What did you major in? B: Hotel management; I work in a hotel now.|管理
A：您讲得真好，讲完我____就明白了。谢谢您！ B：别客气，还有不懂的就来问我。|A: You explained well; I understood immediately. Thank you! B: Ask if anything else is unclear.|一下
从北京____高铁去上海，四五个小时就能到，特别快。|Taking high-speed rail from Beijing to Shanghai takes four or five hours.|乘坐
下雨天妈妈总是____我，出门时别忘了带雨伞。|On rainy days Mum reminds me to bring an umbrella.|提醒
夏天比较热，出汗多，所以我一般不____手表。|Summer is hot and sweaty, so I usually do not wear a watch.|戴
他今天是第一次参加比赛，所以十分____。|It's his first competition today, so he's nervous.|紧张
大家正不知道怎么办时，小文想出了一个好____，这个难题马上就解决了。|When nobody knew what to do, Xiaowen had a good idea and the problem was solved.|主意
A：明天有什么安排？ B：明天就安排了一个____——八达岭长城。因为有些远，需要坐高铁去。|A: What is planned tomorrow? B: One attraction, Badaling Great Wall. It's far, so we'll take high-speed rail.|景点
A：八达岭长城的____太美了，我很喜欢。你以前来过吗？ B：来过，这是我第三次来了。|A: The scenery at Badaling is beautiful. Have you been before? B: Yes, this is my third visit.|风景
A：你怎么了？感觉这段时间你的工作效率____了。 B：可能是因为最近晚上睡不着，休息不好。|A: Your efficiency seems to have fallen. B: Perhaps because I haven't been sleeping well.|下降
A：这道菜看着不太好吃，我不想吃。 B：____挺好吃的，你尝尝。|A: This doesn't look tasty; I don't want it. B: It's actually good; try it.|实际上
A：我刚收到通知，今天下午要停水。 B：那咱们赶快多接点儿水，____做不了饭了。|A: Water will be cut off this afternoon. B: Let's store some now, otherwise we can't cook.|否则
这次比赛____了很多同学参加，大家都表现得非常积极。|This competition attracted many students, who participated enthusiastically.|吸引
我特别喜欢吃水果，____喜欢吃香蕉。|I love fruit, especially bananas.|尤其
今天是妈妈的生日，我和爸爸给她买了生日蛋糕，一起给她唱生日歌，____她永远年轻、美丽。|It's Mum's birthday. Dad and I bought a cake, sang and wished her lasting youth and beauty.|祝
人要对自己说过的话____，说到就一定要做到。|People should take responsibility for their words and keep promises.|负责
这位新同事做事积极，____也很好，大家都很喜欢她。|The new colleague is enthusiastic and has a pleasant personality; everyone likes her.|性格
A：他们夫妻两人的____一直特别好。 B：是的，他们家真是一个幸福的家庭。|A: The couple have always had a close relationship. B: Yes, theirs is a happy family.|感情
A：你结婚的____定了吗？ B：嗯，定在了下周六，到时候你一定要来啊！|A: Have you set your wedding date? B: Yes, next Saturday. You must come!|日子
A：我希望自己遇见的____简单、美好，你呢？ B：我的想法和你一样，我也希望遇到简单的人，结婚后过简单的日子。|A: I hope for simple, beautiful love. B: So do I: a simple person and a simple married life.|爱情
A：我记得第一次看这个电影时，我都感动得哭了。 B：嗯，我对它的印象也很____。|A: I was moved to tears when first watching this film. B: It made a deep impression on me too.|深
A：看完刚才的足球比赛，你有什么____？ B：我觉得球员们踢得很精彩，尤其是8号，表现特别好。|A: How do you feel after that match? B: The players were excellent, especially number eight.|感受
这个时候你还是不要乱说话，否则可能会____更大的误会。|Don't speak carelessly now, or it may cause a greater misunderstanding.|引起
为了保护环境，我们学校每年都____垃圾分类活动。|Our school holds waste-sorting activities yearly to protect the environment.|举办
老师说我们一定要学好知识、打好基础，____还要多出去走走，了解市场情况。|The teacher said to learn well, build foundations and also go out to understand the market.|此外
这本书太____了，一个星期都看不完。|This book is too thick to finish in a week.|厚
每个人平时都应该注意____用水，不要浪费。|Everyone should conserve water and avoid waste.|节约
A：老师今天怎么一直咳嗽？ B：____啊，是不是感冒了？|A: Why is the teacher coughing all day? B: Exactly, could it be a cold?|就是
A：北京那天只有零下五____，你们还是去了长城？ B：是的，我们去爬了长城。虽然温度低，但风不大，不觉得冷。|A: It was minus five Celsius; you still went to the Great Wall? B: Yes, with little wind it didn't feel cold.|摄氏度
A：你怎么回来了？ B：那里太冷了，我实在____那儿的气候。|A: Why are you back? B: It's too cold there; I cannot stand the climate.|受不了
A：不好意思，我____说得不太好。 B：没有啊，我觉得您说得挺好的。|A: Sorry, my standard Mandarin isn't very good. B: I think you speak well.|普通话
A：这些垃圾不能放在一起，不____。 B：好的，我们马上就把它们分好类。|A: Don't mix this rubbish; it's not environmentally friendly. B: We'll sort it now.|环保
